BrochureContent.Content:
Corofin is an attractive semi-detached property situated on the highly regarded Hartland's Avenue, just off Glasheen Road in one of Cork City's most established and sought-after residential locations. The property has been converted into two self-contained 1-bedroom residential flats, with the conversion benefiting from pre-1963 planning exemption. 
The property occupies a generous site with the significant benefit of a large west facing private rear garden, providing excellent outdoor amenity space for the occupiers while also offering potential for extension, subject to planning permission. To the front, the property enjoys off-street parking for up to 3 cars.

One of the property's principal attractions is its immediate proximity to The Lough, the location is exceptionally well served by local amenities. University College Cork, Cork University Hospital, the Bon Secours Hospital, and Wilton Shopping Centre are all within easy reach. Cork City Centre is approximately a 10 to 15-minute walk, while the area benefits from regular public transport services and excellent road connectivity via Glasheen Road and the South Ring Road network.
